1.consolidated_definition: Palma de hasta 6 m de altura, con tronco liso y delgado, erecto y cilíndrico, con anillos, copa rala, flores blancas y fruto redondo. Arecaceae; Euterpe globosa.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Palm tree up to 6 m in height, with smooth and slender trunk, erect and cylindrical, with rings, sparse crown, white flowers, and round fruit. Arecaceae; Euterpe globosa.
